info.summary: A personal diary and health journal
info.description:
# NextDiary
A personal diary and health journal for Nextcloud.
## Features
* **Markdown editor** - write diary entries with full Markdown support * **Multiple entries per day** - create several entries for the same date * **Mood & wellbeing tracking** - rate your mood and wellbeing on a 1-5 scale * **Tags** - organize entries with tags, auto-extracted from #hashtags * **Symptoms** - track health symptoms across entries * **Medications** - log medications linked to diary entries * **File attachments** - attach files to entries, stored in Nextcloud * **Calendar navigation** - jump to any date, highlighted days with entries * **Configurable sidebar** - show/hide sections, reorder tags/symptoms/medications * **Export** - download entries as Markdown or PDF (single entry, day, date range, or all) * **Localization** - 88 languages with full translations included
